prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production art direction lineup for a real top-down mobile UFO game.
Reference image1 is the approved low-poly gouache material and character style. Reference image2 is the EXISTING navy soldier identity to evolve.
Create ONE landscape image of exactly THREE distinct comic infantry characters standing separately across pure white, all fully visible from helmet to boots, each holding their own distinct weapon. One single front three-quarter view per character, generous white spacing, no labels/text/background/scene/ground shadows.
Same game family: chunky economical low-poly forms with broad visible hand-painted gouache brush strokes in albedo, warm peach faces with simple dark dot eyes and noses, oversized bean boots, charcoal/navy uniforms, muted steel-blue highlights, coral double-chevron threat markings on weapon/armor; charming slightly incompetent rural military, not realistic violence. Painterly texture is essential, not shiny plastic.
LEFT RIFLEMAN: medium compact build like existing soldier, round low navy steel helmet, rolled sleeves, navy shirt and shorts, brown belt/boots, one slim coral shoulder stripe. Holds a compact boxy navy carbine with one stock, short square magazine and thin single barrel, both hands low-ready across chest, muzzle angled upward a little toward viewer-right, fingers readable.
CENTRE SHOTGUNNER: noticeably short/broad stocky proportions, wide flat-brim navy helmet, oversized blocky padded navy vest, bare peach forearms, wider stance and large boots. Holds ONE short chunky double-barrel break-action shotgun with TWO large side-by-side dark muzzle holes and broad warm wooden stock/foregrip; thick stubby silhouette unlike the rifle. Both hands support it across belly.
RIGHT ROCKET TROOPER: taller/lankier than other two, narrow navy body, tall angular navy helmet with large simple ear pads, small square integral backpack, dark long trousers and bean boots. Carries ONE oversized simple charcoal/navy shoulder launcher resting on right shoulder with rounded coral rocket tip visible at forward end, chunky rear tube and two simple grips; no complicated mechanism. Distinct long tube silhouette over the shoulder.
Constraints: exactly3 people, exactlyone gun each; no vehicles, minigun, flames, smoke, tracers, muzzle flashes, gore, bases, badges with writing, logos, real-world weapon branding or extra detached items. Distinct clear silhouettes in same painterly style, not three reskins.
